open_items: Diagnosis (evidence: the three r01 archives fetched to ~/.cache/chim_r2). The wipe (run 6bf52232, pull 1) had no knockout at Massacres 1 and 2. The doubled swing about 9.5 s after Massacre 2 found the Feral at 83,041/244,890 health: hit 1 left 1 health, hit 2 killed. In those 9.5 s he got about 52k healing while the Discipline Priest and Restoration Shaman healed DPS at 1 health. The next doubled swing, 15 s later, found the Blood DK alone at 146,575 health with 4 Break stacks: 137,363, then lethal. The burn hold at 23% then kept a tankless raid through a Feud into Mortality, and the boss killed it one member at a time down to 8.4%. Batch 1's only death was the Feral to the Mortality doubled swing 1 s before the kill (WCL fight 27: the tank died 2 s before the kill).

Round-2 changes (owned): (1) Post-Massacre soak. From the native Massacre timer (26-14 s left) the Double Attack soaker (the Double Attack tank, or the victim when alone) is tier 1 toward 95%. The first raid healer joins the tank healer on him once the victim is off the floor. No Slime lands before 19 s after the cast start. (2) Burn release on Feud with 10 s or more left and both tanks at 80%+: batches 1 and 2 held 12-27 s at 20-23% while the boss was pacified. Also release on fewer than two living tanks. (3) Hunters: 33 yd spread arc; the outage stack becomes a 21.5/25.125/28.75 yd column on the rear axis while a hunter lives. Bands are at most +/-1.5 yd wide with a 0.5 yd arrival tolerance; static asserts guarantee the 6 yd Slime split between neighbouring bands at the worst tolerance corner.

Decision: keep the native Break/Double Attack timers (no swing-bound model). Live doubled swings were 13.5 s after each Massacre cast start and 14.6 s apart; WCL was 13.6 s and 14.4 s, within one swing. The native 11 s Break lands on the Break tank, who holds the boss then. A swing-bound Break would put it on the Double Attack tank's doubled swing. No Break-stack swap: under the mixture a Break-stacked single swing only needs 10,000+ health. No boss-window death in round 1 came from a single swing on the Break tank.

Survival Hunter 33%: an encounter positioning cause, not class. Hunter shots have a 5 yd minimum range that Spell::GetMinMaxRange extends by the melee range: 27.8 yd from the centre of a 20 yd-reach boss. The spread put him at 22.0 yd and the outage stack at about 8 yd. On the counted kill he had 138 idle min_range_required waits and about 1,395 shot rejections (spender 487, dot 417, auto_attack 296, resource_generator 195), 82 melee swings at 22.8 yd, and 17 Auto Shots. His damage was DoT ticks, the pet and melee. Batches 1 and 2 were mostly outage (knockouts after Massacres 1-3 and 1-4). Fixed by the formation change; needs the live batch to confirm.

Stall classification: batch 2 (250536fd) was excluded for world-tick stalls. There were 11 native stalls of 0.5-0.73 s (4 attributed to console commands, 7 unattributed), 4.5% of the boss window against a 2% limit, on the shared round worldserver. That is infrastructure, not the encounter. Run 6bf52232's watchdog plateau came after a real kill: pull 2 (respawned boss guid 183) died at T+466.9 to Cobra Shot, then every bot kept validation_route_advance_pending=true with reason boss_killed for 190 s. Route/terminal scope for the coordinator: check the terminal advance after a wipe, a native reset and a second pull that kills a new boss object. The Feral also died on the killing swing.

Knockout rule is still a fidelity conflict; the native script is unchanged. Native: 40% at Massacre 1 (+20% per miss, back to 40% after a knockout). DBM: never after Massacre 1; after Massacre 2 or 3; Massacre 3 always. Live round 1 knocked out after Massacre 1 in 2 of 4 pulls, then repeatedly; no WCL kill shows one. No source gives the Massacre 2 probability. Needs several longer WCL 10N kills or wipes (Astra extraction). It moves outage share, and so hunter and melee DPS, between runs. encounter_research stays fidelity_blocked (knockout rule, Slime repeat, berserk).

Mortality deaths: the user notes they are expected (healing -99%), and WCL fight 27's only tank also died there. The target keeps max_boss_window_deaths 0, so a Mortality-phase exception is a scoreboard policy change that needs an explicit user decision and coordinator tooling. Not changed here.

Class evidence (class agent; no class files edited): Demonology Warlock 31% (counted kill, 1.56M damage): 24 Drain Life channels (75.5k) and 4 Incinerates, no Shadow Bolt filler, 27 idle max_range_exceeded and 33 movement_requires_instant_action waits, 847 mana_gate rejections of its resource generator. It channels Drain Life at low health, which the mixture floor makes unnecessary. Fire Mage 84%: mana-starved (48 idle mana_gate waits, 1,943 resource_generator mana_gate rejections), and another packet has an uncommitted Combustion edit. Blood DK 80%: WCL-only Blood Tap, Dancing Rune Weapon and Empower Rune Weapon; largest gap Melee to Heart Strike 2.7 s. Survival Hunter WCL-only: Cobra Shot, Kill Shot and Lock and Load (range-blocked, see above).

Review P1 (GPT-6 Astra) fixed in place: the first column (20/24.5/29.5 yd, 1 yd stack tolerance) accepted a corner with the hunter 0.9 yd back and the middle band 0.9 yd forward, where the hunter's Slime had 1 recipient. Now: front 21.5, middle 25.125 and rear 28.75 yd, band half-width capped at 1.5 yd, and a column-only arrival tolerance of 0.5 yd (StackSlotTolerance; the compact 8 yd ring keeps 1 yd). Static asserts: (band gap)^2 + (2 x half-width)^2 <= (6 - 2 x tolerance)^2 for both neighbour pairs; rear - tolerance > 27.83 yd minimum range; front + tolerance < 22.83 yd melee range. New tests: the hunter-back/middle-forward corner (nobody moves, 6 players share the hunter's Slime), the mirror melee/middle corner, re-positioning just beyond the tolerance, and a 7-member middle band compressed to +/-1.5 yd.
risks: The outage column splits a Slime six to nine ways instead of ten (neighbouring bands are guaranteed within 6 yd, but the melee and hunter ends are not): casters and the hunter take up to 39k from a Slime on the hunter, and melee/tanks up to 26k. Outage healing is by health percentage, with Barrier and Spirit Link cast from the healers' band.

Post-Massacre double coverage leaves one raid healer on the raid floor for about 10 s. The window closes 16 s after the cast start, 3 s before Slime resumes. Engage 0-12 s is also inside the window (harmless: the soaker is full).

The Feud-window push enters Mortality with the Bile-O-Tron still offline. It returns 4 s before Feud ends, so the first doubled swing meets the mixture floor as on the ordinary release. If Feud ends mid-Mortality, the Double Attack tank (who taunted during Feud) takes the doubled Mortality swing unhealable, as on any release.

Hunter geometry relies on the boss staying near home (the formation centre while he is within 12 yd). The rear column slot is 28.75 yd with a 0.5 yd tolerance, 0.42 yd outside the 27.83 yd minimum range. The column's 0.5 yd tolerance may cause a few more corrective moves than the 1 yd stack tolerance. The 6 yd split is checked in 2D on the flat chamber floor; the spell's own radius check also adds combat reach, so it is conservative.
All changes are header-only in owned Chimaeron files; a build and a live batch are required before any acceptance claim.

validation_neutrality: Only Chimaeron-owned headers under Encounters/Chimaeron, their tests and research files changed. They run only for the bwd.chimaeron.* route nodes and boss entry 43296, so Stonecore, calibration and legacy Magmaw behavior and results are unchanged. There is no native script, SQL, DamageModifier or shared-runtime change. Live effect needs the round build and a Chimaeron batch.
